We derive O(nm), O(m^2), and O(nm^2) algorithms for detecting induced P5, P6, and P7 respectively. To the best of our knowledge, the previous best algorithmic upper bounds which are given by Hoang, Kaminski, Sawada, and Sritharan [6] for detecting induced P5, P6, and P7 are O(m^2), O(nm^2), and O(m^3) respectively when considering both number of vertices and edges of the host graph.

results.problem: Induced P_{2k} detection in bipartite graphs
results.quote: Given an m-edge bipartite host graph H as input, we can detect whether H has an induced P_{2k} in \widetilde{O}(m^{k-1})-time.
